+## What
+The Layer-3 source of truth (plan §3, §6, §7, §7.1; decisions #13/#14/#25/#28). Composes discovery → decode → validate → listing into one reloadable registry.
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Registry/SkillsRegistry.swift`:
+  - Init `(stack: DotfolderStack, policy: RenderPolicy, watch: Bool)` — builds the catalog once at construction; if `watch`, wires `SkillWatcher` → rebuild.
+  - Visibility model (§6 table): default = both surfaces; `disable-model-invocation` = user-only; `user-invocable: false` = model-only; `preload: true` = both + body injected; `partial: true`/validation-hidden = neither.
+  - `metadata() -> [SkillMetadata]` — id, rendered description (passes 1+3), parameter summaries, model-visibility flag; initial list at construction, refreshed list on reload.
+  - `onReload` observation (AsyncStream or callback) publishing the refreshed metadata.
+  - `preloadedBodies() -> String` — rendered bodies of `preload: true` skills (render via the current pipeline; full fidelity arrives with the M5 render tasks).
+  - `commandListing() -> [SkillListing]` — user-surface rows (§6.1), model-hidden-but-user-invocable included, `user-invocable: false` excluded.
+  - `call(id:arguments:) throws -> String` — dereference the live catalog, render the body with arguments; unknown/hidden id throws a typed error carrying current ids (ops convert to correctives later).
+  - `diagnostics` — the validator output with provenance.
+- Rebuild swaps the catalog atomically (actor or lock) — readers never see a half-built catalog.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Fixture-stack registry: visibility table proven for all four §6 rows (default/`deploy`/`lint`/preload fixture arrives later — cover `preload` with a temp-dir skill)
+- [ ] `call` renders `commit` with arguments and throws the ids-carrying error for unknown ids
+- [ ] Editing a temp-layer `SKILL.md` triggers exactly one rebuild and one `onReload` publication with refreshed metadata
+- [ ] `commandListing()` and `metadata()` disagree exactly on the two visibility-split fixtures (`deploy`, `lint`)
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillsRegistryTests.swift` — construction snapshot over fixtures; visibility matrix; call/arguments; unknown-id error; reload-over-temp-dir case
+- [ ] `swift test` — exit 0
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
